summary: Connect exposure, contractor and assurance data to safety decisions. Explore this practical occupational safety analytics training course.
lede: Occupational safety analytics helps OHS managers, safety leads and operations teams use safety evidence to guide management decisions. The training covers defining leading indicators, checking data quality, interpreting exposure trends, comparing contractor performance and connecting assurance findings to risk. Participants also practise shaping management dashboards and reviewing predictive signals as decision-support inputs, with human review remaining central and no coding or model development required.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who interpret occupational safety information or use it to set priorities, oversee controls and report risk. It suits people who already work with safety processes and want to improve the management use of their data.
audience: Operations managers using exposure trends to prioritize
prerequisites: Working knowledge of occupational health and safety processes and routine safety reporting is recommended. Basic incident investigation, introductory safety compliance and ISO 45001 training are not course content. No coding or programming is required; predictive analytics is covered at conceptual awareness and decision-support level.
